facts.raw_span: A 52-year-old woman
normal BMI (23.5)
history of controlled asthma (no medication needed)
routine use of rosuvastatin (20 mg) daily
experienced moderate severity symptoms including fever, weakness, headache, fatigue, and dry cough lasting for three weeks
not requiring hospitalization
developed joint symptoms, followed by acute back pain and paresthesia
morning stiffness and knee pain, more severe in the mornings and improving throughout the day
Small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger
Total leucocyte count: 6.62 cells/μl (normal range)
C-reactive protein (CRP): normal
Rheumatoid factor (RF): negative
